reviews.title: The Best Pencils
reviews.body: These are, hands down, my favorite lead pencils of all time! The colors are absolutely beautiful - my favorite pastel colors of pink, purple, and blue. The lead is long-lasting and very difficult to break with its thickness. The erasers stay in the pencil well and work to erase writing when needed. We use these for homeschooling, and they're the favorite pencils for both of my girls. These are also a great deal for the quality, and the large package size make them last a long time even with a lot of use. These are my go-to pencils that I plan to keep buying forever. Amazing quality and so pretty!

reviews.title: The Perfect Student Pencil—Smooth Writing, Gorgeous Colors, and Infinite Erasers!
reviews.body: If you are stocking up on school supplies for the upcoming year, this bulk pack of BIC Xtra-Smooth Pastel Mechanical Pencils is an absolute home run. They combine the legendary reliability of BIC with a refreshing, colorful aesthetic that makes everyday note-taking a lot more fun.The Good: Genuinely Smooth Writing and Durable LeadThe "Xtra-Smooth" label is entirely accurate. The 0.7 mm medium point lead glides across loose-leaf paper, graph paper, and notebooks effortlessly without scratching or catching. It strikes the perfect balance for students—it is thick enough to resist snapping under heavy writing pressure during timed tests, yet sharp enough to keep handwriting neat, legible, and crisp.The aesthetic upgrade is fantastic. Instead of the classic, boring clear-and-yellow look, these pencils come in a beautiful array of soft pastel colors. It makes them easily identifiable if they roll off a desk, and teenage students love the stylish, modern look.Reliable Advancing Mechanism and Plenty of ErasersThe advance mechanism is perfectly calibrated; one click pushes out just the right amount of lead so you aren't constantly breaking off excess tips. Furthermore, the erasers are excellent. They wipe away mistakes cleanly without leaving dark smudges or tearing thin notebook paper, which is a lifesaver during math or chemistry classes. Buying them in bulk is an amazing value that ensures you'll have plenty of pencils to last through the entire school year, even with friends constantly borrowing them.Final VerdictBIC has perfected the budget-friendly mechanical pencil, and this pastel pack adds a wonderful touch of style to a classroom staple. They are dependable, comfortable to hold for long lecture sessions, and write beautifully. This is a must-have bulk purchase for students, teachers, or home offices alike!

reviews.title: Cute Mechanical pencils
reviews.body: If you’re looking for a reliable mechanical pencil that won’t empty your wallet, the BIC Xtra Smooth is a standout. Not only is it more affordable than what you’ll find at big-box office supply stores like Staples, it also performs just as well—if not better. The grip is comfortable for extended writing or sketching sessions, the eraser works cleanly without smudging, and the mechanism feeds lead smoothly without jams. I’ve used these for daily note-taking, quick sketches, and grading, and they never let me down. For the price, it’s an excellent value and makes a practical addition to any pencil case.

features: BUY A BIC AND WE’LL GIVE A BIC: This back to school season, when you purchase BIC pencils, we will donate one to teachers and classrooms in need

NO SHARPENING EVER NEEDED: Click the built-in eraser to advance the lead, which means students stay focused in class and never need to leave their seat to sharpen
